description:
Codifica un texto como código QR (ISO/IEC 18004, versiones 1 a 40, corrección L/M/Q/H, modo numérico, alfanumérico o bytes UTF-8) y devuelve la matriz de módulos y un SVG. Cuándo: hay que convertir bytes o texto a esta codificación, o desde ella, con exactitud y sin adivinar. No para: construir una URI data (data-uri-build). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Encodes text as a QR Code (ISO/IEC 18004, versions 1-40, error correction L/M/Q/H, numeric, alphanumeric or UTF-8 byte mode, automatic mask) and returns the module matrix and an SVG. Port of the Nayuki reference encoder; no image decoding. When: bytes or text have to be converted to or from this encoding exactly, without guessing. [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Encodes text as a QR Code (ISO/IEC 18004, versions 1-40, error correction L/M/Q/H, numeric, alphanumeric or UTF-8 byte mode, automatic mask) and returns the module matrix and an SVG. Port of the Nayuki reference encoder; no image decoding. When: bytes or text have to be converted to or from this encoding exactly, without guessing. Not for: building an RFC 2397 data: URI from text or base64 bytes and a MIME type, using base64 or percent-encoding (data-uri-build). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

boost_ecc.description: Raise the ECC level while the version does not grow (boolean; optional; default false).

border.description: Quiet-zone width in modules for the SVG (the standard asks for 4) (integer; optional; default 4; min 0; max 16).

dark.description: Dark module color (string; optional; default "#000000"; up to 7 chars; pattern ^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$).

ecc.description: Error correction level: L ~7 %, M ~15 %, Q ~25 %, H ~30 % of codewords recoverable (optional; one of: L, M, Q, H; default "M").

include_matrix.description: Include the module matrix (rows of "1" dark / "0" light) (boolean; optional; default true).

include_svg.description: Include the SVG string (boolean; optional; default true).

light.description: Light module color (string; optional; default "#ffffff"; up to 7 chars; pattern ^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$).

mask.description: Mask pattern 0-7, or -1 to choose by the ISO penalty rules (integer; optional; default -1; min -1; max 7).

max_version.description: Largest version allowed (integer; optional; default 40; min 1; max 40).

min_version.description: Smallest version allowed (integer; optional; default 1; min 1; max 40).

mode.description: Encoding mode; auto picks numeric, alphanumeric or byte for the whole text (optional; one of: auto, numeric, alphanumeric, byte; default "auto").

text.description: Text to encode (UTF-8 in byte mode; at most 2953 bytes at version 40-L) (string; required; up to 7089 chars).

name: qr-encode
title: Generar código QR
